layer: warm   visibility: local
recorded: 2026-10-06 18:24 · 4m ago

The added second of latency comes from the provider's per-address rate
limiting rather than from cold starts on our side.

arguments.name: latency-test-ambiguous-result
arguments.body: Latency test result (2026-10-06): ambiguous. Rate limiting explains the daytime spikes but not the overnight spikes. Cold starts have the opposite explanatory gap: they may fit the overnight spikes, but do not explain the daytime ones. Neither hypothesis accounts for the full pattern. We cannot separate the causes with current instrumentation, so attribution remains unresolved; do not treat either as established.
